description:
## Mission
Add repository governance and toolchain scaffolding files to THIS repository, mirroring the structure and spirit of the reference repository `***REDACTED-PATH***`.

## Files to add (brand-new only)
- LICENSE - MIT license text mirroring the reference repo, holder line adapted to the Bitty project ("Copyright (c) 2026 The Bitty Terminal Contributors" style - match the exact phrasing style used by the reference LICENSE).
- CONTRIBUTING.md - adapt the reference: development setup, Conventional Commits expectation, delivery lifecycle Issue -> Branch -> Commit -> PR -> Review -> Merge, pointer to AGENTS.md and justfile quality gates.
- SECURITY.md - supported versions section marked unreleased, private vulnerability reporting via GitHub Security Advisories, disclosure policy and response expectations.
- CHANGELOG.md - Keep a Changelog 1.1.0 format with only an "## [Unreleased]" section.
- commitlint.config.ts - mirror the reference conventional-commits configuration.
- .markdownlint-cli2.jsonc - mirror the reference markdownlint-cli2 configuration (ignore globs for node_modules, target, dist, build, site).## Hard constraints
- First inspect the repo with `ls -la`: SKIP any matrix file that already exists and record that fact instead of overwriting.
- DO NOT modify ANY existing file (no AGENTS.md, README.md, justfile, package.json, wrangler.jsonc edits). Tooling wiring proposals (lefthook, just targets, CI workflows) go into a progress note as recommendations for a follow-up post-initialization task.
- No commits, no pushes, no remote/git state changes. Git write operations are NOT authorized for this task.
- If main becomes born mid-task (another agent pushed the initial snapshot), stop adding files immediately, record what is complete, review + hand off.
- English-only content. Describe files as proposed scaffolding, never as implemented product behavior.
- The reference repo is READ-ONLY evidence: do not execute, build, install, or copy anything from it beyond adapting the listed governance files.

## Verification
- Every matrix file either present or explicitly skipped-because-exists.
- Links inside CONTRIBUTING.md/SECURITY.md resolve within this repository.
- CHANGELOG follows Keep a Changelog headings; commitlint.config.ts is syntactically plausible TypeScript (visual check only, no installs).
- One progress note per nontrivial decision; list final added/skipped set in the last note.

## Closure
- Progress notes -> checkpoint -> `task review` (stop at IN_REVIEW; NEVER complete the task yourself).
- Handoff HO addressed to commander `opencode` summarizing added files, skipped files, and wiring recommendations.
title: Add governance and toolchain scaffolding files

description:
## Summary

Make bitty-devtools actually exercise the CTX-0320 live client campaign by
wiring a headless-testable conformance harness onto devtools' existing
Dispatcher / IpcTransport seams. Cross-repository source task: bitty CTX-0325;
campaign reference: bitty `recording/ctx-0320/CAMPAIGN.md` + evidence.

## Scope (bitty-devtools only)

- `src/campaign.ts` (new) plus `tests/campaign.test.ts` (new), re-exported from
  `src/index.ts`; no changes outside devtools + its tests.
- Live checks are opt-in/gated; all probes are headless-testable via a pluggable
  dispatcher seam. Timeouts everywhere.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Per-verb envelope v1 + exit-code conformance over the `ctl` verb matrix
   (JSON envelope shape; exit 0/2/6/7/8 and NotFound semantics; ScopeDenied=7).
2. Workspace id round-trip guard: ids from `workspace list` are usable in
   `workspace focus` / `workspace close` (D2 regression guard).
3. `ctl terminal text` shape guard: plain grid text, never a Rust `Debug`
   `Snapshot { ... Cell { ... } }` dump (D1 regression guard).
4. `ctl terminal spawn` observability guard: view/terminal list and
   `has_pane_session` must change (D3 regression guard).
5. `BITTY_SOCKET` parent-dir 0700 preflight: clear, actionable diagnostic
   (name the offending mode and the `chmod 700` remedy) instead of the raw
   mode-mismatch refusal.
6. Panel/plugin coverage hooks present and explicitly marked post-D4; must not
   block or fail the harness.

## Evidence required

- `just check` green (fmt-check, lint, type-check, cargo-check) and
  `bun test` green; CI green on the PR.
- Headless tests covering PASS and the D1/D2/D3 failure injections.
title: feat(devtools): live client campaign conformance harness (CTX-0325)

description:
Priority: P2 | Area: tooling | Labels: fix,area:tooling,P2 | Milestone: v0.1.0 | Task: CTX-0325

DEFECT (bitty-devtools campaign harness @ origin/main 7d51b8f): ProcessCtlDispatcher hardcodes the client env `BITTY_CTL_ELEVATE=1` (src/campaign.ts, dispatch()), but bitty's elevation allowlist parses comma-separated scope names (e.g. `terminal.manage,config.modify`; unknown tokens grant nothing). The live campaign therefore cannot exercise any elevated success path: probe `terminal:spawn-observable` (elevated:true) always fails Denied/ScopeDenied, and the denial probes pass for the wrong reason.

Repro: `bun campaign-live.ts` against a live bitty whose server allowlist includes terminal.manage still reports:
FAIL terminal:spawn-observable :: spawn failed: Denied/ScopeDenied
while a direct `bitty ctl terminal spawn` on the same instance succeeds.

Fix: drive elevation with the scope list (e.g. env { BITTY_CTL_ELEVATE: "terminal.manage,config.modify" }) and document that elevation is a server-side pre-grant, not a client flag.

Evidence: recording/ctx-0324/round2/logs/devtools-live-campaign.json, ctl/elevation-format.txt, ctl/elevated-verification.txt.
Do not fix under this task.
title: campaign: ProcessCtlDispatcher sets BITTY_CTL_ELEVATE=1, blocking elevated success probes
